text: You can find the average score for the week by following the value up from the horizontal axis and seeing where the line intersects with the vertical axis. If we want to find out the average score in week 1, we follow the value up the graph and see that the line intersects with the value 3 on the vertical axis. This tells us that the average score in week 1 was 3.

instruction.text: Year 5 take a spelling test every week and their average scores are recorded. Look at the line graph and answer the questions.

atoms.a: In which week was the average score 5?
For how many weeks was the average score 8?
For how many weeks was the average score above 4?

instruction.text: This line graph shows the average temperature in January for different years. Look at the line graph and answer the questions.

atoms.a: Which year had the highest average temperature in January?
Which year had the lowest average temperature in January?
In which year was the average temperature in January 4°C?

instruction.text: This line graph shows the average number of ice creams sold each month in 2021. Look at the line graph and answer the questions.

atoms.a: For how many months were an average of 20 ice creams sold?
In which month were an average of 80 ice creams sold?
How many months had an average of 60 or higher?
